dbe_source.recommendation: The period of y = sin(bx) is 360/b. Do not just divide 180; always divide 360 by the coefficient b. For tan, the base period is 180, so period = 180/b.

lesson.concept: The period of y = sin(bx) is 360/b. Do not just divide 180; always divide 360 by the coefficient b. For tan, the base period is 180, so period = 180/b.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

example.problem: State the period of y = sin 2x

probe.problem: State the period of y = tan 2x.

learner_message: The period is 360 divided by the coefficient of x (or 180 divided by it for tan). Yours used a different divisor.
